description: A real report in Spanish scoped to the [bug, docs] taxonomy. The warrant configures `languages: [en, vi, zh, es]`; detection resolves Spanish by profile among four Latin candidates. The verdict names `bug` over the floor, and the warrant grants `label` and `comment` — triage applied end to end on a Romance-language thread.
warrant:
version: 1
labels:
  - name: bug
    description: Something that used to work and does not.
  - name: docs
    description: The documentation is wrong or missing.
languages:
  - en
  - vi
  - zh
  - es
duties:
  triage: [label, comment]

thread.title: El modo oscuro no se guarda al recargar la página
thread.body: El modo oscuro no se guarda después de recargar la página. Revisé la configuración, pero siempre vuelve a los valores por defecto cada vez que abro la página. Espero que lo puedan corregir pronto.

verdict-over.rationale: La configuración no se conserva al recargar la página.
